feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Feedback and complaints may be filed at the City Agriculture Office, Barangay Gogon, Barriada, Legazpi City, or by telephone, mobile or email.

services.title: Requesting seeds, seedlings, fertilizer or fingerlings
services.description: Release of agricultural and fishery production inputs to farmers, fisherfolk and organisations: palay and vegetable seeds, planting materials, fertilizers, tilapia and bangus fingerlings, and mangrove seedlings.
services.whoMayAvail: Farmers, Fisherfolks, Schools, Religious Groups, Students, Entrepreneurs, Employees, Government Office, CSOs and Walk-in Clients

requirements.item: Request letter from the President of the association or organisation
Approved letter from the City Mayor

steps.client: Request production inputs (vegetable seeds or seedlings, fertilizers, palay seeds, planting materials or fishery inputs).
steps.agency: Assist the client in filling up the visitor's logbook.
Ask for the request form for agri-inputs for record purposes.
Check availability of seeds and planting materials, then issue a requisition slip.
Forward the requisition slip to the City Agriculture Office for approval and signature.

steps.client: Sign the forms and fill up the release logbook.
steps.agency: Assist the client to sign the forms and fill up the logbook for release.

steps.client: Proceed to the bodega or nursery, wait for release and receive the agri inputs.
Fill up the Client Satisfaction Form.

services.title: Getting agri-fishery technical advice or a farm visit
services.description: Technical assistance and answers to agricultural and fishery queries, including scheduling of site visits and requested trainings or lectures.
services.whoMayAvail: Farmers, Fisherfolks, Schools, Religious Groups, Students, Entrepreneurs, Employees, Government Office, CSOs and Walk-in Clients

steps.client: Ask for agri-fishery technical assistance or raise a query.
steps.agency: Refer the client to the Agricultural Technologist or the person concerned, who discusses the matter, advises what to do next, and schedules a site visit, training or lecture as requested.

steps.client: Fill up the Client Satisfaction Form.

notes: The charter marks the 15 minutes as applying under normal circumstances, per transaction.

services.title: Getting an RSBSA, PCIC insurance or boat registration certificate
services.description: Issuance of certifications and enrolment in the Registry System for Basic Sectors in Agriculture (RSBSA), PCIC crop insurance, and boat registration.
services.whoMayAvail: Farmers, Fisherfolks, Schools, Religious Groups, Students, Entrepreneurs, Employees, Government Office, CSOs and Walk-in Clients

requirements.item: Filled-up form, secured from the Agricultural Technologist assigned

steps.client: Request a certification, or enrolment in RSBSA, PCIC insurance or boat registration.
steps.agency: Refer the client to the Agricultural Technologist or person concerned, who schedules a site visit or validation if necessary. If already validated, proceed to the Admin Section for printing of the certificate.
Forward the certificate to the City Agriculture Office for signature and approval.

steps.client: Proceed to the Admin Section to receive the certificate.
Fill up the Client Satisfaction Form.
